+def catmull_rom(points, steps=100):
+    """Interpolating Catmull-Rom curve, returned as densely sampled pixel xy."""
+    p = np.asarray(points, dtype=float)
+    ext = np.vstack([p[0], p, p[-1]])
+    out = []
+    for i in range(len(p) - 1):
+        a, b, c, d = ext[i:i + 4]
+        for t in np.linspace(0, 1, steps, endpoint=False):
+            t2, t3 = t * t, t * t * t
+            q = 0.5 * ((2*b) + (-a+c)*t + (2*a-5*b+4*c-d)*t2 + (-a+3*b-3*c+d)*t3)
+            out.append(q)
+    out.append(p[-1])
+    return np.asarray(out)
+
+
+def resample_curve(points, ds_px=0.45):
+    p = np.asarray(points, dtype=float)
+    lengths = np.r_[0., np.cumsum(np.linalg.norm(np.diff(p, axis=0), axis=1))]
+    targets = np.arange(0, lengths[-1], ds_px)
+    if not len(targets) or targets[-1] < lengths[-1]:
+        targets = np.r_[targets, lengths[-1]]
+    return np.column_stack([np.interp(targets, lengths, p[:, j]) for j in range(2)])
+
+
